content.title: What’s the Difference Between Diet Coke and Coke Zero?
content.text: What’s the real difference between Diet Coke and Coke Zero? They’re both sugar-free, calorie-free, and wear the Coca-Cola name—but why do they taste different? And who are they actually made for? In this episode of History of Simple Things, we break down the surprising origins, sweeteners, branding strategies, and flavor profiles behind these two popular drinks. Whether you're a loyal Diet Coke drinker or a die-hard Coke Zero fan, this video will help you understand what truly sets them apart—and why they both exist. Grab a cold can and join us for a fizzy deep-dive into cola chemistry and clever marketing. ⏱️ Timestamps: 00:00 – Intro: Viewer Suggestion! 01:06 – The Origins: When Diet Coke and Coke Zero Were Born 02:19 – What’s Inside: Sweeteners and Ingredients Compared 03:39 – Taste Test: How They Actually Taste Different 04:54 – Who Are They For?
